title: 🔆🔅 IRGC Navy captures a US spy and deception drone west of the Strait of Hormuz
text:
🔆🔅 IRGC Navy captures a US spy and deception drone west of the Strait of Hormuz"

"Public Relations of the Navy of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps:"

"🔹 The combatants of the Electronic Warfare Unit of the IRGC Navy, relying on the power of Almighty God, during an offensive electronic-warfare operation, succeeded in detecting, identifying, and taking control of the guidance and control systems of an MQM-170 spy and deception drone belonging to the US “terrorist army” west of the Strait of Hormuz, and landed it intact on the ground."

"🔹 The drone’s mission was to identify the air-defense systems of the Islamic Republic of Iran along the coast of the Persian Gulf and the Strait of Hormuz. Based on information recovered from the aircraft by IRGC Navy specialists, it was determined that the drone’s flight had originated from the coast of one of the southern littoral states of the Persian Gulf.
